title: Take the current ia plugin release on ia host claude --user
summary: Rerunning ia host claude --user --apply now brings an installed ia plugin to the public catalogue's current release: after the marketplace add and install it runs claude plugin marketplace update inventarch and claude plugin update ia@inventarch --scope user --json. Both do nothing when the plugin is already current. A rerun from the public catalogue now needs the network. An update Claude holds back, for example because another plugin pins ia to an older version, is refused with Claude's reason instead of reported as done, and the install is recorded as soon as it succeeds. Restart Claude Code, or run /reload-plugins, to load an update.
